panels.title: Publish chain — coverage and missing data

options.content: **Prometheus-translated names; job=youban.** 本轮只读查询验证：主助手 Grafana 工具确认 `xiaohuiji_tg_api_requests_total` and operation/result/upload_mode labels; no environment/service/runtime labels are attached to that business metric. Optional instance filter defaults to All and matches absent instance. Display/verify filter applies to media phase and new transport purpose panels. Legacy counts are execution observations, never unique profiles. Missing data stays missing. Resource metadata needs a separately verified, environment-scoped target_info join.

panels.title: Observed API attempts / second (no phase label)
panels.description: Counts actual instrumented API attempts, including fallback calls. Does not cover every Telegram method. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Phase send operations / second — $phase
panels.description: Phase send operations may contain multiple API calls; not Telegram message volume. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Observed API error fraction (≥20 attempts / 5m)
panels.description: 0..1 fraction of the selected instrumented API attempts. Empty below 20 attempts or without a denominator. No phase filter. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Phase send P95 — $phase (≥20 observations / 5m)
panels.description: Classic histogram P95 in seconds. Hidden below count gate; display and verify are never mixed into one quantile. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, phase) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_tg_media_send_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",phase=~"$phase"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (phase) (sum by (phase) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_tg_media_send_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",phase=~"$phase"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Observed API attempts — selected range
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected range; not unique jobs. No phase label. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Phase send observations — selected range / $phase
panels.description: Includes error, timeout, canceled; one send operation can contain multiple requests. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Legacy publish execution observations (no phase label)
panels.description: Heterogeneous send attempts plus fallback finalization. Success may precede commit. Never use as profile totals or committed job success ratio. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Legacy creation-to-send-entry P95 (retry inclusive)
panels.description: Job creation to each send execution entry, including retries/prior elapsed work. Not pure queue wait; no phase label. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Delete fallback lifecycle events / second
panels.description: queued/started/retry/success are events for overlapping tasks; never sum as task completions. No phase label. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Delete fallback failure events — selected range
panels.description: Failures are lifecycle observations, not distinct failed jobs. Absent event series remain No data. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

options.content: Source-confirmed singular metrics: `xiaohuiji.publish.job.transitions` → `xiaohuiji_publish_job_transitions_total`, and `xiaohuiji.publish.job.duration` → `xiaohuiji_publish_job_duration_seconds_{bucket,sum,count}`; status=sent/failed/superseded. Sent shared completion and superseded lifecycle hooks are wired. Typical send failures are now hooked after changed committed terminal transitions in handleTelegramJobError. Watchdog/batch terminal paths remain incomplete: no full success-rate SLO or complete failure census. Counts are changed postcommit observations, not distinct profiles/lifetime unique jobs. Projection commits are terminal-confirmation plus channel-plan transactions, not eventual async profile/index projection.

Narrow by environment/service/time, then use `jobId` + `operationNo` across attempts; `executionId`, `taskId`, `queueRetryCount` identify a retry. Follow `traceId` into traces and `log_type=telegram_publish_stage` / `telegram_publish_summary` into logs. Detailed logs and traces are sampled. Nested stage durations cannot be summed as wall time. Configure actual log/trace datasource UIDs separately; none are invented here. Healthy global throughput cannot exclude a stalled channel: per-channel eligible backlog, age, progress and inventory freshness are required. New structured logs use traceId/jobId/attemptId/durationSeconds where available; cleanup retains traceID/durationMs. Account phase-send observations can contain multiple RPCs and must remain separate from concrete Bot API calls.

panels.title: Recovery step observations / second (scan success ≠ repaired)
panels.description: Existing bounded step invocation outcomes. Item errors can be logged and continued despite step success. Media phase filter does not apply. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Confirmed-job recovery item attempts / second
panels.description: phase is a repair phase, unrelated to the display/verify filter. Retries count again; not distinct repaired jobs. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Last confirmed-job page size — fresh samples only
panels.description: Last bounded ordered page count, NOT global backlog. No aggregation across replicas; hidden when observation is older than 180s or in the future. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Oldest unchanged age in confirmed-job page — fresh only
panels.description: Gauge in seconds, not histogram. Oldest now-updated_at in queried bounded page, not proof that the whole channel is stalled. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Time since successful confirmed-job page scan
panels.description: Unix timestamp freshness, not time since export. Successful empty scan advances timestamp; failures do not. Missing instances require expected inventory. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: Recovery step P95 (≥20 observations / 5m)
panels.description: Step duration in seconds; no relation to total end-to-end job latency. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, step) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_recovery_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (step) (sum by (step) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_recovery_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Time since observed publish runtime heartbeat
panels.description: last_seen is Unix seconds, emitted by the existing 30s loop per enabled role. Missing expected roles need configured inventory, not inference from observed series. Media phase filter does not apply. Scoped to job=youban; no unverified resource-label enrichment.

panels.title: New transport API attempts / second — purpose $phase
panels.description: Concrete Bot calls including relay; actual account RPCs outside these files are not represented by handoff events. Phase maps to purpose. Unknown is not success; retries are separate attempts. Legacy operation dropdown does not filter this panel. Scoped to job=youban without invented resource labels.

panels.title: New transport API P95 — purpose $phase (≥20 / 5m)
panels.description: Concrete Bot calls including relay; actual account RPCs outside these files are not represented by handoff events. Phase maps to purpose. Unknown is not success; retries are separate attempts. Legacy operation dropdown does not filter this panel. Scoped to job=youban without invented resource labels.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, purpose) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_api_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",purpose=~"$phase"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (purpose) (sum by (purpose) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_api_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",purpose=~"$phase"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Finished stage invocations / second — returned ≠ success
panels.description: One finished invocation per observation including retry/duplicate/conflict/panic. No media-purpose label. Stages nest and durations must not be summed.

panels.title: Stage P95 (≥20 finished observations / 5m)
panels.description: Stage duration excludes queue backoff; parent and child durations overlap. Returned only means function returned, not committed business success.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_stage_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (stage) (sum by (stage) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_stage_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Terminal-confirmation transaction attempts / second
panels.description: Labels kind=terminal_confirmation, outcome=success/failed/timeout/canceled/noop, error_class. Invocations count retries; success is a changed top-level confirmation commit, noop adds no committed transition. Not later async profile/index projection.

panels.title: Terminal-confirmation attempt P95 (≥20 / 5m)
panels.description: Transaction attempt duration, including failed/timeout/noop attempts; seconds. Top-level guard excludes ambient transactions. Not eventual asynchronous projection completion.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_projection_attempt_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",kind="terminal_confirmation"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (kind) (sum by (kind) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_projection_attempt_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",kind="terminal_confirmation"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Media fallback lifecycle events / second — purpose $phase
panels.description: Branch and account handoff lifecycle events may overlap for one job. Account handoff is not a measured account RPC. Events never sum to completed jobs. recovered is not inherently success: missing_or_terminal_account_task yields outcome=unknown/error_class=unknown; confirmed_facts_restored remains success. Reason is log-only; correlate via logs. The outcome breakdown preserves this distinction.

panels.title: Changed terminal-confirmation commits / second
panels.description: Success changed only after top-level transaction. Terminal confirmation plus channel plan, not eventual async profile/index projection; kind=terminal_confirmation.

panels.title: Changed terminal-confirmation commit P95 (≥20 / 5m)
panels.description: Only changed committed terminal-confirmation transactions; do not compare against attempt P95 as if they were the same population.

panels.title: Recorded terminal transitions / second — partial failed coverage
panels.description: Source-confirmed singular job.transitions. Sent shared completion and superseded lifecycle hooks are wired; typical send-path terminal failures are now observed; watchdog/batch paths remain incomplete. No full success-rate SLO. Changed postcommit transition observations, not unique jobs/profiles.

panels.title: Recorded creation-to-terminal P95 (≥20 / status / 5m)
panels.description: Source-confirmed singular job.duration. Valid creation timestamp to changed terminal commit; retry-inclusive lifetime. Failed call-site coverage is incomplete; compare only the recorded population.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, status) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_job_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (status) (sum by (status) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_job_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Cleanup invocation observations / second
panels.description: One observation per invocation, retries repeat. settled_attempt is not distinct cleanup intents; deferred/requeue/nil return are not business completion. Reason derives from CleanupOperationNo. Media phase does not apply.

panels.title: Cleanup whole-attempt P95 (≥20 / reason / 5m)
panels.description: Selects stage=attempt only; nested cleanup durations overlap and must never be summed. Media phase does not apply.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, reason) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_cleanup_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",stage="attempt"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (reason) (sum by (reason) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_cleanup_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",stage="attempt"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Account PHASE send attempts / second — purpose $phase
panels.description: High-level account/protocol phase sends, NOT underlying RPC count. A phase may issue multiple RPCs; retries repeat. Confirmed requires all expected IDs; nil/empty/incomplete responses are unknown. Keep separate from concrete Bot API calls.

panels.title: Account PHASE duration P95 (≥20 / purpose / 5m)
panels.description: High-level phase duration, not per-RPC latency; excludes task queue residence. Do not combine with Bot API histograms or use account phase counts as Bot API denominators.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, purpose) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_account_phase_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",purpose=~"$phase"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (purpose) (sum by (purpose) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_account_phase_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",purpose=~"$phase"}[5m])) >= 20)

panels.title: Bot switches / second — independent of media phase
panels.description: Bot failover branch event purpose=unknown, transport=bot, outcome=unknown. Deliberately ignores display/verify filter so default display does not hide failovers. Not an API request or job completion.

panels.title: Concrete Bot delete calls / second — outcome
panels.description: One actual DeleteMessage invocation per observation, including retries and partial-send rollback. true,nil=deleted; false,nil=unknown; already_absent is separate idempotent resolution. Counts are not unique deleted messages. Bot only; protocol deletes have event/stage coverage. Media phase filter does not apply.

panels.title: Concrete Bot delete P95 (≥20 / outcome / 5m)
panels.description: Per concrete Bot DeleteMessage call latency in seconds, including failed/timeout/canceled/deferred outcomes. Separate from whole cleanup invocation and nested-stage duration. No underlying protocol-delete RPC latency claim. Media phase filter does not apply.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, outcome) (rate({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_cleanup_message_duration_seconds_bucket",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",transport="bot"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (outcome) (sum by (outcome) (increase({__name__="xiaohuiji_publish_cleanup_message_duration_seconds_count",job="youban",instance=~"$instance",transport="bot"}[5m])) >= 20)
